title: RelationEdgeV0
description: A single directed relation edge between two knowledge entities, identified by their entity ids. Upgrade relations are canonicalized to a single 'upgrades_to' direction (from the earlier tank to the later one); reverse ancestry is derived from the graph rather than stored as a separate 'upgrades_from' edge type. Referential integrity of from_id/to_id against an actual entity set is deliberately NOT checked here -- JSON Schema validates document shape, not cross-document graph consistency, and this schema does not pretend otherwise.

from_id.description: Entity id this edge originates from (e.g. the earlier tank in an upgrades_to edge, or the base shape in a variant_of edge).

to_id.description: Entity id this edge points to (e.g. the later tank in an upgrades_to edge, or the variant shape in a variant_of edge).

relation_type.description: upgrades_to: tank progression edge, canonical direction only (no upgrades_from). variant_of: a shape/polygon variant relation (e.g. Pentagon -> Alpha Pentagon), structurally distinct from tank progression.

status.description: Mirrors the source wiki's own qualifiers, e.g. an upgrade path documented as a 'removed upgrade option' (observed on the sampled Twin/Smasher pages).
